name: neobrutalism-inputs
title: Inputs
description: Neobrutalism-style input components built with Tailwind CSS. Featuring thick borders, hard shadows, and bold focus states. Ideal for search bars, contact forms, and data entry with a distinctive retro look.
useWhen: Collecting short text, search terms, or identifiers in a bold neobrutalist form.
Pairing an input with a recognizable icon or a direct search action.
avoidWhen: Collecting long-form prose — use a textarea.
Choosing from a fixed list — use a select or radio group.
responsiveBehavior: Inputs stretch to container width on mobile while icons and buttons remain inside or adjacent to the field without clipping.
accessibility: Every input requires a visible label or accessible name.
Do not use placeholder text as the only label.
